recentItems.title: Raymond Cusick at The Day of the Daleks convention
recentItems.description: The Day of the Daleks was a one-day Dalek convention which took place at the Adelphi Hotel in Liverpool on November 11th 2000.  In this previously unreleased interview, production designer Raymond P Cusick talks about creating a unique and timeless design classic.

recentItems.title: John Scott Martin and Cy Town at The Day of the Daleks convention
recentItems.description: The Day of the Daleks was a one-day Dalek convention which took place at the Adelphi Hotel in Liverpool on November 11th 2000.  In this previously unreleased interview, veteran Dalek operators John Scott Martin and Cy Town talk about their time working on Doctor Who, from the 60s through to the 80s.

recentItems.title: Roy Skelton at The Day of the Daleks convention
recentItems.description: The Day of the Daleks was a one-day Dalek convention which took place at the Adelphi Hotel in Liverpool on November 11th 2000.  In this previously unreleased interview, actor and voice artist Roy Skelton talks about career and his work on Doctor Who specifically.
